question: What is the algorithm used to create word embeddings?
title: Shared Task: Lexical Semantic Change Detection in German
answer_rationale: Text 4 and Text 10 mention the use of SGNS (Skip-gram with Negative Sampling) as the algorithm for creating word embeddings. Text 4 states that the model by BIBREF5 is based on SGNS, and Text 10 refers to a model based on SGNS with vector initialization alignment and cosine distance.
